competences: Identify the three government organs and their duties.
Explain who leads and forms the Executive.
languageCompetence: Read, spell and write the key Social Studies terms used in this lesson.
objectives: Name the three organs of government.
State who heads the Executive and who makes it up.
State the duties of the Executive.
references: P.5 Social Studies Lesson Notes Term III: Uganda as an Independent Nation

steps.teacherActivity: Introduce the three organs using the source's three cooking stones comparison.

source.quote: At home, the mother prepares food on three cooking stones

steps.teacherActivity: Explain the work of the Executive, Legislature and Judiciary.
Describe who heads and belongs to the Executive.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify the President, ministers and civil servants.

source.quote: This organ is made up of the president, ministers and civil servants.

steps.teacherActivity: Guide discussion and the new written exercises on the Executive's duties.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer questions and review corrections.

assessment: Assess learners with the source-written questions in the exercise and check their correct answers.
